captureCuration.reason: Retain one focused capture per scenario/width; second only for account editor or series-versus-manual choice. All interaction, overflow and browser checks ran before curation. Full raw receipt retained locally outside repository.
captureCuration.selectiveRefresh: General six combinations refreshed after final non-layout maxLength/default-editor-state corrections; all other rendered surfaces unchanged.

document-forms.scope: Invoice, receipt, Shopify and series forms; all final rendered sources unchanged by later panel-only updates.

general-final.scope: General normal/empty refreshed after final panel maxLength and editor default-state fixes.

sourceSha256Scope: Current final source snapshot; each check names its actual capture batch and bundle. Only General panel changed between batches and all six General combinations were refreshed.
jsSha256Scope: Latest General batch; actual bundle per check is recorded in captureBatches.
